subject: Kickoff: romanized input for South Asian languages
body:
Hi Daniela,

Kicking off romanized-input support for South Asian languages. Base is our open-source context-aware transliteration work: users type Hindi, Bengali, or Tamil in the Latin alphabet, and context-aware models map it into native script far better than word-by-word transliteration. The release ships FST-based transliteration via Nisaba with released models, generated text resources, and neural checkpoints on the way.

Product target: a transliteration layer for the language portfolio's input stack — romanized input is how a huge share of South Asian users actually type, and our coverage there is embarrassing.

Plan: FST baseline reproduced by end of May, context-aware neural comparison in June-July, integration recommendation by the 8/3 window close.

Staffing and platform dependencies by mid-May?

Priya
